name: Le Voile de Nirabi
source:
The Veil of Nirabi's Night... A night that celebrates the love between the Star Prince and the Waters Goddess, when the lovers meet to look at the sky together.

A folk tradition in the High-City of Sihalaradh, a symbol of hope and joy for many couples, but a bitter memory for Sijani, young provincial tailor who reached the city to complete his apprenticeship.

However, through opportunities and encounters, Sijani will find himself invested in some festivities preparations... Perhaps he'll get the chance to mend his broken heart, and for the first time, enjoy the Veil of Nirabi's Night into someone’s arms...

[From [url=https://celes-lys.itch.io/the-veil-of-nirabi]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
尼拉比之夜的面纱……庆祝星王子和水之女神之间爱情的夜晚，恋人们一起仰望天空。

这是西哈拉德高城的一项民间传统，对许多夫妇来说是希望和欢乐的象征，但对来到这座城市完成学徒期的年轻外省裁缝西贾尼来说却是一段痛苦的回忆。

然而，通过机遇和遭遇，西贾尼会发现自己投入到了一些庆祝活动的准备中……也许他会得到治愈受伤的心的机会，并第一次在某人的怀抱中享受尼拉比之夜的面纱……

[来自[url=https://celes-lys.itch.io/the-veil-of-nirabi]itch.io[/url]]
